name: EASY HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.
summary: EASY HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. is a South Korean enterprise established in 1988, based in Seoul, operating within the biological resource industry. The company specializes in producing and distributing natural substitutes for antibiotics, environmental improvement agents, and microbial testing kits. Its portfolio extends to supplying agricultural and livestock food products, alongside various feed additives. Furthermore, EASY HOLDINGS is actively engaged in biotechnology, feed solutions, and agro-livestock infrastructure projects, as well as the provision of processed meat items and diverse investment activities.
